safety_review.initialization: HostedAutonomousStore.__new__ and SimpleNamespace journal bypass constructors that initialize schema or local directories; HostedSources and AutonomousKnowledge constructors create only in-memory state.
safety_review.dispatch_guards: Exact clean 8f source and six module hashes, exact TursoDatabase type, dedicated default client factory, open nonredirecting borrowed client, pinned HTTPS origin/path, exact generated SELECT allowlist, fixed read-only transaction/close envelopes and bounds checked before client dispatch.
safety_review.client_and_limits: Borrows existing product client without changing HOME, timeouts, retries, 12-second SDK deadline or 32-MiB per-response bound. Adds cooperative 300-second maximum, 160 observed-request maximum and 256-MiB payload-body budget.
safety_review.cleanup: ExitStack restores borrowed client identity and instance method/lock attributes on success or failure, including removal of temporary overrides of inherited attributes. Probe does not close borrowed client.
safety_review.output: Fixed labels, durations, counts, dependency versions, hashes and class-only failures; no tokens, endpoints, SQL text, parameters, journal/source contents or trace info are exported.
safety_review.measurements: TCP includes DNS; no observed connect event proves reuse. Header/body measures are native client intervals. Read-method timings overlap and include local protocol/JSON work. Residual is expressly not pure network or CPU time. Probe-owned locks measure isolated acquisition overhead. Encoding times cover FastAPI primitives, not ASGI scheduling or a full request.

Redact setup/cleanup exceptions and count preflight within the cooperative budget.
